senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. זָהַב)to be bright, shine.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 18a:5">Men. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>צָהֲבוּ פניו וכ׳</he> the face of R. J. brightened up (with joy); <cite ref="Chullin 7b:4">Ḥull. 7ᵇ</cite>; a. e.—Part. pass. <cite ref="R00132"><he>צָהוּב</he></cite>; pl. <he>צְהוּבִין</he>.
<cite ref="Nedarim 49b:8">Ned. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>היום פניך צ׳</he> thou lookest bright to-day.—V. <cite ref="R00132"><he>צָהוֹב</he></cite>.
Sifré Deut. 309 היה עומד וצוֹהֵב כנגד וכ׳ stood up and insulted a senator in the street; Yalk. ib. 942.—Part. pass. as ab. jealous, angry.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 105a:13">Snh. 105ᵃ</cite> <he>שני … צ׳ זה לזה</he> (Ms. O. a. Ar. <he>צוֹהֲבִין</he>) two watchdogs … who were jealous of each other. Tanḥ. Vaëra 14 <he>אש וברד צ׳ וכ׳</he> fire and hail are hostile to each other (cmp. <cite ref="D00038"><he>דָּבַב</he></cite>).

senses.gloss: to become shining. Sifra Vayikra, N’dab., Par. 6, ch. VIII משיַצְהִיבוּ when the feathers of the pigeons begin to be shining, contrad. to הזהיב (of grown doves) to shine, v. זָהַב; Ḥull. 22ᵇ

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Middot 2:3">Midd. II, 3</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="N00482"><he>נְחוּשְׁתָּן</he> I</cite>.—Part. pass. <cite ref="M00574"><he>מוּצְהָב</he></cite>; f. <he>מוּצְהֶבֶת</he>.
Yoma 38ᵃ (some ed. מְצוּהֶבֶת Pu.), v. נְחוּשְׁתָּן I. [Ib. והיתה מאירה, Ms. M. 2 מַצְהֶבֶת.]

<cite ref="Moed Katan 24b:4">M. Kat. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>כיוצא … רבים מַצְהִיבִין עליו וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>מצווחין</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) if a corpse is carried out on a bier, the people grieve over it (in sympathy) &c.
